findings.title: Social application route points to unrelated examples
findings.description: The quick path directs agents building posts, comments, votes, or feeds to policy-examples.md. That page was read in full and contains only a team SaaS policy, a marketplace, and a realtime game. It has no social/content policy. Because this file explicitly tells agents to open exactly the named page and stop, the route leaves a common build without the promised ownership, moderation, voting, and feed guidance.
findings.recommendation: Point this row to a real social/content example, or add a complete social policy covering authorship, immutable votes, moderation authority, and feed visibility before retaining the current route.
